# Crates

Generated by `conductor-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 4 packages. None is on a registry; build them from the repository. The domain types live in `crates/conductor-model`, which `ess` generates from `spec/` and which is outside the workspace.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conductor-broker` | [`crates/conductor-broker`](https://github.com/beyond10x/conductor/tree/main/crates/conductor-broker) | `use conductor_broker` | The broker of one conductor instance: one socket per session, the grant check, the call record and the verbs the `tool` binary calls. |
| `conductor-cli` | [`crates/conductor`](https://github.com/beyond10x/conductor/tree/main/crates/conductor) | `use conductor_cli`, binary `conductor` | The conductor command line: the `cli:` block of spec/components.yaml, in clap derive form. |
| `conductor-docs` | [`crates/conductor-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/conductor/tree/main/crates/conductor-docs) | `use conductor_docs`, binary `conductor-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the conductor documentation site (CLI, config, crates, status) and checks them for drift. |
| `tool` | [`crates/tool`](https://github.com/beyond10x/conductor/tree/main/crates/tool) | `use tool`, binary `tool` | The `tool` binary every session of an instance acts through: the verbs of its grant, from the command line or as an MCP server, each answered by the instance's broker over the session's socket. It opens no store and holds no admin command. |
